descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name מָנוֹחַ (Manoah/Manoach), the father of Samson from the tribe of Dan (Judg 13:2-22, 16:31). The name is related to the root נוח 'to rest,' meaning 'rest' or 'resting place.' All 18 occurrences refer to the same individual. Multilingual evidence is consistent: eng Manoah/Manoach, spa Manóaj/Manoa, hin मानोह, arb مانوحُ, kor 마노아, swa Manoa. The minor spelling variant 'Manoach' in one English rendering and the conjunction-prefixed forms are orthographic/grammatical differences, not semantic distinctions.
